newsitem.title: USA: PVC Container holder to sell stake.
newsitem.headline: PVC Container holder to sell stake.

text.p: PVC Container Corp said its majority holder, Rimer Anstalt, agreed to sell a stake in the company to Kirtland Capital Partners.
Rimer holds about 63 percent of PVC's outstanding shares.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed in PVC's statement.
The proposed deal, which is subject to the completion of due diligence, finalization of a definitive agreement and regulatory approval, is expected to close by the end of the year.
Kirtland Capital is a private-funded investment group with over $100 million in equity capital.
PVC manufactures and distributes plastic containers and compounds.
